mda.name: National Identity Management Commission
mda.description: National Identity Management Commission identity, card, diaspora and institutional verification services.

officialChannels.name: NIMC official website
officialChannels.instructions: Use the official NIMC website to find the current service instructions, centres and approved channels. FeeLens does not collect NIMC payments.

nimc-charter.title: NIMC Service Charter, February 2026
nimc-charter.documentReference: Printed pp. 1–34; PDF pp. 4–37. The supplied PDF is 38 pages and begins with three unnumbered pages.
nimc-charter.notes: The supplied project copy is titled February 2026. No more precise provider publication or effective date is stated in the document body or PDF metadata. Fee rows are cited to both printed and PDF page numbers. The requested official URL returned 502 Bad Gateway during the 31 October 2026 web check, so byte-for-byte equality with the supplied copy is not established. The FeeLens-hosted copy has SHA-256 77c7f3405dde318d32946570ab14a437c1d552ebdd892c5cda6ecddb440057b9 and is the owner-supplied file, not a claim of a successful re-download.

nimc-fees.title: NIMC official fees page
nimc-fees.notes: The official NIMC fee page was accessible through the official site/search index on review. It lists current fee-page values, including ₦28,574 for date-of-birth modification, ₦2,000 per updatable field, and NIN slip re-issuance options. It also describes NVS as negotiable by access level and the NVS API as currently free for approved, registered developers; that scope differs from the charter's institutional API fee table.

nimc-modifications.title: NIMC adult modification process
nimc-modifications.documentReference: Modifications (Adults): fee, requirements and process sections
nimc-modifications.notes: The official adult modification page was accessible through the official site/search index on review. It states ₦15,000 for date-of-birth change and ₦500 per field for other service fees, creating an unresolved conflict with the official fees page and February 2026 charter.

nimc-nin.title: NIMC National Identification Number page
nimc-nin.documentReference: NIN: eligibility, enrolment, issuance and collection sections
nimc-nin.notes: The official NIN page supports eligibility, enrolment, collection and the distinction between self-service pre-enrolment and in-person biometric enrolment.

nimc-slip.title: NIMC re-issuance of NIN slips page
nimc-slip.documentReference: Re-Issuance of NIN Slips: loss, damage, theft and record-change sections
nimc-slip.notes: The official slip page supports the reasons for re-issuance, stated documents and the published process. Its older payment examples are retained as process evidence and are not used to silently override the charter fee rows.

nimc-self-service.title: NIMC self-service modifications page
nimc-self-service.documentReference: Self-Service Modifications: supported changes, steps and documents
nimc-self-service.notes: The official NIMC self-service page supports online modification for name, phone number, date of birth and address, with the listed document requirements.

nimc-diaspora.title: NIMC diaspora services page
nimc-diaspora.documentReference: Diaspora: licensed partners, locations and fee context
nimc-diaspora.notes: The official diaspora page supports diaspora enrolment through licensed partners and explains that infrastructure and operations abroad are borne by those providers. It does not establish a particular charter fee row by itself.

nimc-home.title: NIMC official website
nimc-home.documentReference: Official service navigation and service links
nimc-home.notes: The official NIMC website is the verified public starting point for service navigation. It does not by itself establish every fee in this catalogue.

rows.name: First-time enrolment and NIN slip
rows.audience: Individual citizens and legal residents
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists first-time enrolment and NIN slip as Free. NIMC's NIN page says enrolment and obtaining a NIN are free and explains that biometric capture occurs through the enrolment process.
rows.notes: Regular service; self-service pre-enrolment may be available, but final enrolment and biometric verification are centre-based.

rows.name: Premium enrolment (VIP service)
rows.audience: Individual applicants choosing a booked premium service
rows.location: Nigeria; premium partner locations or special lounges as described by the charter
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Premium Enrolment (VIP Service) at ₦20,000 and describes it as prepaid through premium partners or special lounges.
rows.notes: Optional premium service; the charter does not establish a named partner or a self-service route.

rows.name: NIN slip re-issuance (premium local)
rows.audience: Individual applicants using the premium local service
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists NIN Slip Re-issuance (Local) under Premium Enrolment at ₦3,500.
rows.notes: Premium/local fee row; the charter does not specify whether loss, damage or another condition applies to this premium option.

rows.name: Child-to-adult NIN migration (Nigeria)
rows.audience: Individuals moving from child to adult NIN status
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Child-to-Adult NIN Migration as Free. The NIN page confirms that minors are enrolled before age 16 and that card eligibility differs by age.
rows.notes: The charter does not provide a separate online process or requirements for this migration.

rows.name: Card issuance (local)
rows.audience: Individual card applicants in Nigeria
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists local General Multi-Purpose Card issuance at ₦7,000. NIMC's official site identifies the GMPC/e-ID card as an NIMC service.
rows.notes: Card service; the charter does not establish a public self-service application path for this fee row.

rows.name: Card replacement (local)
rows.audience: Individual card holders needing replacement in Nigeria
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists local General Multi-Purpose Card replacement at ₦7,000.
rows.notes: The charter does not specify the replacement condition or a self-service channel for this row.

rows.name: Card delivery (inter-city)
rows.audience: Individual card holders requesting delivery within Nigeria
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Card Delivery (Inter-City) at ₦5,000.
rows.notes: The charter does not establish the delivery provider, booking route or conditions.

rows.name: Card delivery (inter-state)
rows.audience: Individual card holders requesting delivery across Nigerian states
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Card Delivery (Inter-State) at ₦7,500.
rows.notes: The charter does not establish the delivery provider, booking route or conditions.

rows.name: Card issuance (diaspora)

rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Card Issuance (Diaspora) at $20.

rows.name: Card replacement (diaspora)
rows.audience: Nigerian diaspora card holders needing replacement
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists Card Replacement (Diaspora) at $20.

rows.name: Card delivery (diaspora)
rows.audience: Nigerian diaspora card holders requesting delivery

rows.name: NIN slip re-issuance (lost, damaged or stolen)
rows.audience: Individuals whose NIN slip is lost, damaged or stolen
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists ₦600 for NIN Slip Re-issuance (Lost/Damaged Slip), while the official slip page supports loss, damage and theft as re-issuance reasons and describes supporting documents.
rows.notes: Centre-based process is supported by the official slip page; the charter fee row says lost/damaged and the official page also names theft.

rows.name: NIN slip via self-service portal
rows.audience: Individuals retrieving or printing their NIN slip online
rows.location: Online; NIMC self-service or official portal
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists NIN Slip via Self-Service Portal at ₦1,000. The official NIMC site links users to official digital ID and slip-printing resources.
rows.notes: The charter supports a self-service channel but does not name the exact portal URL in the fee table; follow the current official NIMC route.

rows.name: NIN slip re-issuance after record change or modification
rows.audience: Individuals who have completed a NIN record change or modification
rows.evidenceNote: The charter lists ₦1,000 for NIN slip re-issuance after record change/modification. NIMC's slip page supports a record-change re-issuance path but contains an older per-field payment example, so the charter row remains the FeeLens fee claim.
rows.notes: The charter does not state whether the ₦1,000 is per field or per re-issued slip; do not infer beyond the published row.

rows.name: Correction of date of birth
rows.audience: Enrolled citizens or legal residents requesting date-of-birth correction
rows.location: Nigeria; centre or supported self-service route
rows.page: Printed p. 28; PDF p. 31; official web pages also recorded

evidenceNotes.nimc-charter: The February 2026 charter lists Correction of Date of Birth (Day/Month/Year) at ₦28,574.
evidenceNotes.nimc-fees: The current official NIMC fees page lists ₦28,574 for date-of-birth modification.
evidenceNotes.nimc-modifications: The official adult modification page states ₦15,000 for a change of date of birth and also states ₦500 per field for other service fees.
evidenceNotes.nimc-self-service: The official self-service page describes an online date-of-birth modification route but does not resolve the fee conflict.

rows.notes: Conflicting official amounts remain visible: ₦28,574 (charter and fees page) versus ₦15,000 (adult modification page). FeeLens does not select one amount. The official process page supports an in-person route and the self-service page supports an online route for some users; confirm the amount shown by NIMC before payment.

rows.name: Change of other NIN information (name, address and similar fields)
rows.audience: Enrolled citizens or legal residents changing an updatable NIN field
rows.location: Nigeria; centre or supported self-service route

evidenceNotes.nimc-charter: The charter lists Change of Other Information (Name, Address, etc.) at ₦2,000.
evidenceNotes.nimc-fees: The current official fees page lists ₦2,000 per updatable field.
evidenceNotes.nimc-modifications: The official adult modification page lists a service fee of ₦500 per field, which conflicts with the charter and current fee page.
evidenceNotes.nimc-self-service: The official self-service page supports online modification for selected fields but does not resolve the fee conflict.

rows.notes: Official NIMC sources disagree: ₦2,000 in the charter and fees page versus ₦500 per field on the adult modification page. The record remains conflicting; confirm the amount and whether it is per field or per request before payment.

rows.notes: Conflicting official scope and fee information. The charter fee is retained as a source-specific option, but FeeLens does not present it as conclusively current for every approved developer.

excludedRows.name: Information permitted by access levels — Levels 0–5
excludedRows.reason: The charter records verification token units, not a monetary fee. The current fee model has no separate non-currency unit type, so these six access entitlements are preserved in the matrix but not published as monetary fee cards.

excludedRows.name: Diaspora system-management annual renewal dash entries
excludedRows.reason: The charter prints a dash in the annual-renewal column for new-centre creation and system activation. No fee claim is published for a dash.
